description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Weakness +9% Boost 3]/[Weakness +15% Boost 3]/[Weakness +30% Boost 3] to all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF12 allies are alive, grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Sky Pirate] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Sky Pirate
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Wind abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Wind Blast after using Wind abilities
